how: Element types text/line/box/ring/bars; easings linear, ease_out_cubic, spring_pop (1−e^(−7t)·cos 12t). Each element animates over the first third of its life: progress = ease(min(1, 3·(t−start)/duration)); text scales from 0.5× and rises 35 px; ring draws an arc −90°→+270°; bars grow in a stagger (progress·n − k). The validator rejects odd sizes, >3840 px, fps outside 1–60, >10,800 frames, >100 elements, text >300 chars and non-normalised x/y. ffmpeg: -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgb24 -i - -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p +faststart; optional --audio muxes AAC 160k with -shortest. Re-ran here: 480×854, 24 fps, 4.000 s in 1.7 s wall time. Honest limits seen on the decoded frame at 2.5 s: the BARS block grows up into the second title (layout bug in the sample spec) and only DejaVu is found here (no Noto Sans Arabic), yet the words joined correctly. Full-frame renderer only — no alpha overlay over footage. how: 180° shutter centred: sub-frame k of N at t = (n + 0.5·((k+0.5)/N − 0.5))/fps (N = 4 → offsets −0.1875, −0.0625, +0.0625, +0.1875 frame). Adaptive: luma difference between t−½ and t+½ frame at ¼ resolution; n = 1 if diff < 0.5, else clamp(3 + 1.6·diff, 5, 14), rounded up; ≥ 6 for rolling objects. Clamp sub-frames at hard cuts (the film publishes its hard-cut times); quantise discrete events. Four fixed sub-frames look cheap; masters with 8 sub-frames and shutter 0.5 cost about 20 s of render per film second. Extends ENG-349.
params: n = 1 | clamp(3 + 1.6·diff, 5, 14); ≥ 6 rolling; no straddled cuts

how: Playwright evaluates seek(t); canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9) for each frame (wait for window.FILM_READY); pipe MJPEG into `ffmpeg -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p`; N worker chunks joined with the concat demuxer (-c copy); mux the song with `-c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -shortest -movflags +faststart`. Test frames first (`render.py frames 3,10.5`) and a 4-column contact sheet. Lesson: contiguous chunks are unbalanced, interleave instead (ENG-X02). The owner's film: 1080×1920, 30 fps, 56.92 s, 8 scenes.
license: owner (song audio and lyrics are third-party; not included)

what: خريطة مختصرة لما يجب معرفته قبل بناء فيديو بـRemotion: من التركيب والتوقيت إلى الترجمات والانتقالات والقياس. — A short map of what to know before building a Remotion video: from compositions and timing to captions, transitions and measurement.
when: حين يكون Remotion هو المحرك المختار — when Remotion is the chosen engine.
how: Rule topics: compositions, sequencing, timing (spring/easing), animations, text animations, transitions, trimming, videos, audio, assets, fonts, gifs, lottie, charts, 3D via React Three Fiber, tailwind, measuring text (fit and overflow), calculate-metadata, media helpers (can-decode, extract frames, audio/video duration and dimensions), display captions (pages with word highlight), import SRT, transcribe captions. Check Remotion's licence: some companies need a paid licence.
license: MIT (ECC, (c) 2026 Affaan Mustafa); Remotion has its own licence

name_en: Tool-map doctor before promising a stack
what: أمر واحد يبيّن أيّ أدوات خريطة الأدوات مثبّتة هنا (node، ffmpeg/ffprobe، Playwright وChromium، Remotion، git، yt-dlp، whisper وأصنافه، OpenCV، PySceneDetect، Pillow، numpy، arabic-reshaper، ImageMagick، Blender، GPU) مع تلميح التثبيت؛ الخطة لا تعِد إلا بما هو ✓. — One command lists which catalog tools exist on this machine with install hints; a plan promises only what is marked present.

name_ar: محرك المحاكاة: إعادة بناء فيديو مرجعي بلقطات جديدة
name_en: Mimic engine: rebuild a reference video with new footage
what: خط أنابيب بايثون كامل داخل المهارة: تحليل المرجع (لقطات، انتقالات، طبقة نص بألفا حقيقية وظل بالمربعات الصغرى، مطابقة خط، مظهر لوني) ثم بناء بإطار واحد لكل إطار مرجعي: نقل لوني Reinhard كـLUT، كين بيرنز، الانتقال بمنحناه المقاس، تعتيم وحبيبات معايرة، والنص بالخط المطابَق وحركته المقاسة، والصوت الأصلي منسوخًا بلا إعادة ترميز. — A complete Python pipeline inside the skill: analyse the reference (shots, transitions, text layer with true alpha and least-squares shadow, font match, colour look) then rebuild frame for frame: Reinhard LUT grade, Ken Burns, the transition with its measured curve, solved vignette and calibrated grain, text in the matched font with its measured motion, and the original audio stream copied untouched.
when: the user says 'make me this video but with my clips' (Pinterest-style dua reels, quote videos)
how: Read `references/mimic.md`. `mm_analyze.analyze('ref.mp4','work')` → review `work/analysis.md` and `work/sheets/` → fill `shots[].replacement.path` from the user's or licensed clips (never scraped) → `mm_build.build('work', preview=True)` then full → `tools/verify_video.py`. `placeholder=True` drafts without footage.
params: H.264 bt709 CRF 17, same w×h, fps and frame count as the reference; preview = half size; needs numpy, Pillow(raqm), ffmpeg; OpenCV/SciPy optional
install: pip install numpy pillow opencv-python-headless scipy; ffmpeg
